method: Compact paired reports. All high-depth scores, submitted moves, input positions, hashes and raw timings retained. Lower-depth excluded rows are represented by counts; regenerate full reports with research-screen-study.cjs. Small selected diagnostic corpus; no population-frequency, phone-speed or independent playing-strength claim.

runs.method: Paired fresh workers, alternating order. Same bg6 SIMD WASM and model. Direct Research, Expert then Research, and automatic progressive prefix then Research are separate workloads. Initialization excluded. Diagnostic positions are deliberately selected; not representative or independent strength evidence. Local HTTP, desktop browsers, not physical phones. Single-sample validation runs are not latency benchmarks.
